data.long_meaning: The name Devkiransh is derived from Sanskrit language. It is a compound of two words: Deva (God) and Kiransh (graceful form). The name represents the divine grace bestowed upon an individual. It signifies the blessings of the gods and the manifestation of their presence in one's life. The name Devkiransh carries the meaning “God's (Deva) graceful (Kiransh) form” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Devkiransh usually hope their child will grow to embody god's (deva) graceful (kiransh) form and live with faith, good character and purpose.

Therefore, a name that signifies the divine grace and presence of the gods is highly respected and valued in Hindu culture. The name Devkiransh honors this belief and reflects the deep devotion and respect for the gods in Hindu tradition.
